name: sandboxing accepts fake-tool-result intent (consumer-side defense required)
description: Intent crafted to mimic a tool result is valid printable ASCII and the schema accepts it. Consumers MUST NOT interpolate intent into agent prompts; an adapter that did would expose the receiving agent to fake-tool-result injection.
notes: Pattern: fake-tool-result framing. Defended at consumer layer. Note: when consult message bodies land in Phase 4, additional schema-level constraints MAY tighten this; v0.1 keeps wire validation permissive and concentrates defense at the consumer.
